answer: Work waits on the ember until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the saffron of the next round. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The nadir of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
